semantics.mapping: For each i from 0 through 7, out[i] = in[7-i].
semantics.timing: Combinational continuous mapping; no clock, reset, or added latency. Evidence: original interface contains only in and out and requests bit reversal.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or specified initialization; output follows input, including unknown bits.

numeric.operation: Bit permutation only; no arithmetic or signed interpretation.
numeric.four_state: Preserve each input bit value, including X and Z, at its reversed position.

verification.oracle: Derived from original bit reversal requirement using indexed expected bits.
verification.coverage: Exhaust all 256 binary inputs; directed endpoints, alternating patterns, one-hot patterns, and mixed X/Z values.
verification.sampling: Drive input then wait 1 ns for combinational settling before case-inequality checks.
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch or bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks.
